source: code-archive: Calculator-main.zip (OmniCalc, native Android Kotlin/Jetpack Compose app)
decisions: Native Android app rebuilt as a mobile-first web app (Lovable builds web apps only).

Source had no server, no accounts and stored everything on the phone (Room/SQLite). Web version keeps data on the device (browser storage) to match. Lovable Cloud with sign-in and cross-device sync is offered to the user; not yet decided.
